title: Birthday presents for children
titleCn: 给小孩买生日礼物：玩具公司电话咨询

paragraphs.text: Part one. You will hear a man speaking on the phone to a sales assistant at a toy company.
First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.
Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.
Hello, Ramona Toys. You're through to Tracy. How can I help you?
Good morning. I want to buy birthday presents for my sister's children. She's very keen on educational toys. Do you sell that sort of thing?
Yes. Actually, we specialize in those types of toys. How old are the children?
Well, Peter, he's the oldest. He's going to be nine next week.
Did you have anything particular in mind for him?
I got him a jigsaw last year, but I'd like to get him something a bit more challenging this time. Perhaps something he could make himself.
How about a model truck? Might that be any good? It's made of wood. It comes in a kit, so you get all the pieces, and then there are the electrical components.
Oh, it's not just mechanical then?
Oh, no, it's quite sophisticated. It's recommended for children over eight, and you also get a sheet of stickers to decorate it.
That sounds just up his street, and I'm sure it'd help him to understand technology, even if it's only basic.
Well, yes, and it is a change from the chemistry sets we used to get.
Oh, you had one of those, too, did you?
Um, what about price?
It's 17.50 pound.
Hmm, it's not too expensive then. I could get him something else as well. He's always been interested in animals.
How about a book about jungle animals?
Mm, I think he's already got one.
Okay. Well, how about a bird feeder instead? That's a kit as well. You even get some paint and a brush, so you can decorate it how you like.
Well, that sounds just the thing, and it'd give him contact with wildlife.
Oh, I've just noticed something else in its favor. It's only 8.99 now. It's been reduced from 14.50.
Even better. I'm sure my nephew would like both those things. Now, I've also got to find something for Natalie. That's his sister. She's going to be six soon.
Hmm.
Well, one item that we've just added to our catalog is a chocolate pack.
Hmm, that doesn't sound very educational. Don't you just eat it?

[laughs] Not straight away. It's a kit for making individual chocolates. You heat the chocolate and pour it into special molds. They're provided as well, and you also get some little boxes to put the chocolates in once you've made them.
Oh, I see. I suppose it helps to develop artistic skills then.
Yes, and it says here that it helps children to understand how temperature can affect things. Hmm, seeing chocolate melt and solidify, I suppose. It's just six pounds.
Okay, that's great. Thank you for all your suggestions.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.
Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.
Can I just ask you about ordering?
Well, you can order by phone if you like, or we have a website.
Oh, can you give me the web address, please?
Of course. It's very simple. It's just www.rimona.com.
How do you spell that? Is it R-E-M-O-N-A?
It's R-I-M at the beginning.
Ah, okay.
And then if you already know what you want, you could just do a search.
Okay.
Oh, and I've just seen here, if you order the things before Friday, you don't have to pay for postage. There's a special offer on at the moment.
Oh, good. And I'd probably get the presents sent straight to them. So can I get them wrapped?
You can. Uh, click on packaging options, and you just select gift by ticking one of the boxes. Then it'll be wrapped specially.
Okay. But how will they know who the things are from? Will I be able to send a message?
Yes, you can. That option's on the same menu.
Okay. Well, thanks very much. I'm sure they're going to love all their...
That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
